events.body:
## Context

BLT-CLI (`blt-cli/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-cli): it meets 79% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Bronze (the basics: a README, a description, a licence and a logo)

- **Licence file.** Add a LICENSE file to the folder (most BLT projects are AGPL-3.0; copy the repository root's LICENSE).

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **README links the live site.** Put the live site's address near the top of the README (`**Live Site:** https://cli.owaspblt.org/`).

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Contributing guide.** Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

## Notes

- The README is behind the code: it lists 4 tabs and keys `1`–`4`, but `src/app.rs` and `src/tui/input.rs` have 5 tabs (Issues, Active Hunts, BLT Stats, Logs & Events, Settings) and keys `1`–`5`, plus `/` search, Space to select, `e` export, `p`, `A` and `P`. It also doesn't mention the local scanner (`src/scanner.rs`: Trivy, Semgrep, Bandit) or the MCP watchdog (`src/watchdog.rs`). The new site (cli.owaspblt.org) follows the source.
- The README calls `BLT_API_BASE` a fallback, but `src/main.rs:64` lets it override an explicit `--api-base`. Either fix the precedence or the docs.
- Add `cargo test` to the README's build steps (CI already runs it).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Licence file
- [ ] README links the live site
- [ ] Contributing guide
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-cli` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-cli
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-cli
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
